verdict.rationale: Daytona documents explicit network egress policy controls: firewalls restricting which external IPs/domains a sandbox can reach, configurable at creation or updated live, directly matching the platform-engineer's need to restrict/allow egress with explicit policy. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of firewall enforcement, no detail on policy granularity (e.g., CIDR/domain wildcard syntax) or audit logging of blocked egress attempts.
